title: Zoho CRM Vibe: Build an App by Typing, No Code #Shorts
description:
Zoho CRM Vibe is a new prompt-to-app AI builder announced by Zoho on 23 Nov 2026. Zoho says you describe what you need in plain language and it creates a working app, custom page, live dashboard or tracker on live CRM data, with no coding and no deployment step. Before publishing, an AI Security Review checks the app across six categories. Zoho lists it for Enterprise, Ultimate, Zoho One Enterprise and Zoho CRM Plus. Availability by country and pricing are not covered here.

Source (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- Zoho blog, Introducing Vibe: https://www.zoho.com/blog/crm/introducing-vibe-ai-app-builder-within-zohocrm.html

This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations. Facts are from the source above.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation.
